description: Provision a Google Cloud Datacatalog DataCatalogTaxonomy via Config Connector. Fields mirror the datacatalog.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 DataCatalogTaxonomy spec.

activatedPolicyTypes.description: A list of policy types that are activated for this taxonomy. If not set, defaults to an empty list. Possible values: ["POLICY_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED", "FINE_GRAINED_ACCESS_CONTROL"].

description.description: Description of this taxonomy. It must: contain only unicode characters, tabs, newlines, carriage returns and page breaks; and be at most 2000 bytes long when encoded in UTF-8. If not set, defaults to an empty description.

displayName.description: User defined name of this taxonomy. It must: contain only unicode letters, numbers, underscores, dashes and spaces; not start or end with spaces; and be at most 200 bytes long when encoded in UTF-8.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

projectRef.description: The project that this resource belongs to. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: The `projectID` field of a project, when not managed by Config Connector.

kind.description: The kind of the Project resource; optional but must be `Project` if provided.

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The service-generated name of the resource. Used for acquisition only. Leave unset to create a new resource.
